message.content:
Search the InkOS marketing site at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/InkOS/src/` for all dead links and route references that don't have a corresponding page yet.

1. Find every `href="..."` and `href: "..."` value in the codebase (under `src/`).
2. Group results by category: built routes (have page.tsx), missing routes (referenced but no page), external links, anchor links.
3. Specifically check: nav.tsx mega menu, footer.tsx columns, all Sprint 1-6 pages cross-referencing each other.
4. Report a clean list of MISSING ROUTES — pages referenced by `<a>` or `Link` but no `page.tsx` exists.

Existing routes (built):
/, /about, /blog, /book-a-demo, /careers, /changelog, /contact, /customers, /for/multi-chair, /for/multi-location, /for/small-studios, /for/solo-artists, /legal/cookies, /legal/gdpr, /legal/privacy, /legal/security, /legal/terms, /migrate, /migrate/daysmart, /migrate/fresha, /migrate/mangomint, /press, /pricing, /product, /product/ai-design, /product/calendar, /product/clients, /product/forms, /product/inbox, /product/inventory, /product/messages, /product/payments, /product/projects, /product/today, /reach-compliance, /roadmap

External app:
https://inkos.up.railway.app/login
https://inkos.up.railway.app/signup

Look at:
- src/components/layout/nav.tsx (full mega menu)
- src/components/layout/footer.tsx (4 columns)
- src/app/blog/page.tsx (post detail links to /blog/[slug])
- src/app/customers/page.tsx (story detail links)
- All product pages — `<ProductRelated>` modules + breadcrumbs
- All migrate pages

Report:
- LIST of every unique missing route (path only)
- For each, which file references it (file:line)
- Recommend which ones should ship as real pages vs which can stay as anchors / # placeholders

Under 600 words.
